name: Six-Card Golf
description: A relaxed card game: reveal, replace, and match columns to make the lowest score.

strings.title: Six-Card Golf
strings.phase_flip: Tap two face-down cards to begin.
strings.phase_draw: Tap Stock or the top Discard to draw.
strings.phase_replace: Tap one of your six cards to replace it.
strings.phase_discard: Tap a face-down card to reveal it.
strings.discard_flip: Discard drawn card · reveal a hidden card

rules: Deal six cards to each player in a 2×3 grid. Turn two cards face up to start. On your turn draw from the stock or take the discard, then replace one of your six cards. If you drew from stock, you may discard it to turn one hidden card face up instead. A matching pair in a column scores zero; otherwise add the two card values. Ace is 1, 2–10 count face value, Jack and King are 0, and Queen is 10. When a player turns all six cards face up, each other player gets one final turn. Lowest score wins.
ui_instructions: At the start, tap two of your face-down cards. On your turn, tap the stock or the top discard. Then tap any of your six cards, face up or face down, to replace it with the drawn card. To discard a stock draw instead, choose Discard drawn card and reveal a hidden card, then tap the hidden card to reveal. Cancel returns to replacing a card. A matching pair in a column scores zero.

tutorial.html:
Six-Card Golf

Deal six cards to each player in a 2×3 grid. Turn two cards face up to start. On your turn draw from the stock or take the discard, then replace one of your six cards. If you drew from stock, you may discard it to turn one hidden card face up instead. A matching pair in a column scores zero; otherwise add the two card values. Ace is 1, 2–10 count face value, Jack and King are 0, and Queen is 10. When a player turns all six cards face up, each other player gets one final turn. Lowest score wins.

To discard a stock draw instead, choose Discard drawn card and reveal a hidden card, then tap the hidden card to reveal. Cancel returns to replacing a card. A matching pair in a column scores zero.

tutorial_strings.Deal six cards to each player in a 2×3 g: Deal six cards to each player in a 2×3 grid. Turn two cards face up to start. On your turn draw from the stock or take the discard, then replace one of your six cards. If you drew from stock, you may discard it to turn one hidden card face up instead. A matching pair in a column scores zero; otherwise add the two card values. Ace is 1, 2–10 count face value, Jack and King are 0, and Queen is 10. When a player turns all six cards face up, each other player gets one final turn. Lowest score wins.
